PRO-Rib

Metal Roofing and Cladding

The beauty of PRO-Rib Metal Roofing and Cladding goes much deeper than how good it looks. Because it keeps on looking good for as long as you own it, and even increases the resale value of your home. It provides strong, durable protection to keep your home, cottage or workshop looking great. It’s a beautiful choice for any residential use.

Specifications

  • 28 and 26 gauge Hi-Tensile steel
  • Standard lengths from 4′ to 40′
  • Comes in a wide choice of attractive colours or Galvanized Plus and Galvalume Plus material
  • Low slope capability to 2/12
  • Architectural design flexibility
  • Purlin bearing leg design makes panel alignment and fastener engagement easy and consistent
